source: Project Operating System Phase 4 - Validation Engine
description: Template for future validation approval decisions.
approveWhen: Testing is approved, migration is approved when applicable, all required items pass, no critical nonconformity remains open, and manual approval is recorded.
rejectWhen: Any required dependency is missing, any required item fails, any critical nonconformity remains open, or manual approval is rejected.
notes: Approval records are declarative and do not approve production automatically.
